title: TemporalBench: BENCHMARKING FINE-GRAINED TEMPORAL UNDERSTANDING FOR MULTIMODAL VIDEO MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-only Large Language Models on video question-answering tasks without video inputs to measure the models' reliance on text priors and dataset correlations rather than actual visual evidence.

Testing image-only vision-language models on video tasks to determine if the questions can be answered using static spatial information from a single frame instead of reasoning about temporal dynamics.

Analyzing model predictions to detect the exploitation of 'centralized' description cues among slightly perturbed negative options, and introducing a Multiple Binary Accuracy (MBA) metric to mitigate this evaluation shortcut.
